source_issue.title: unRegisterSlotComponent is in the code, but in the docs it is unregisterSlotComponent

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue reports a discrepancy between the code and documentation in the Volto project. Specifically, the code uses `unRegisterSlotComponent`, while the documentation refers to it as `unregisterSlotComponent`. There is a consensus that the correct term should be `unregister` with all lowercase letters.

## What needs to be done
The goal is to update either the code or the documentation to ensure consistency. You should clarify which one needs changing and proceed accordingly.

## Helpful background
The term "unregister" means to remove an item from a list or service. The confusion arises from inconsistent capitalization: programming often treats case sensitivity as significant. The suggestion is to follow the conventional lower-case spelling for better clarity and accuracy.

## Good first steps
1. Check the instances of both `unRegisterSlotComponent` and `unregisterSlotComponent` in the codebase.
2. Decide whether to update the code or documentation (or both).
3. If you're uncertain or if the discussion feels outdated, feel free to ask questions or seek clarification in the comments.
4. Follow the [first-time contributors guide](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/first-time.html) for best practices on contributing.
```
